title: Thank You Days Since
body:
I’ve been using Days Since since September 5 last year, and it’s been an incredible support system for me. The app’s clean design and easy setup of time counters have helped me stay mindful and motivated while working through personal goals and breaking old habits.

Seeing the days add up is not just encouraging — it’s empowering. Every milestone feels like an achievement, and it constantly reminds me how far I’ve come.

A huge thank you to the developers for creating something so impactful yet simple. It’s been a quiet companion in my journey, and I can’t recommend it enough to anyone wanting to tackle addictions or track positive changes in life.

title: A Quiet, Reliable, Respectful Tracker
body:
I’ve been using Days Since for over 550 days now. What keeps me coming back is how clean and quiet it is. 

I don’t use reminders or notifications, for any app. I just open Days Since when I need it. It gets out of my way. 

I track a few things that matter to me. I like seeing the numbers stack up over time. It helps me notice patterns. When the gaps between events get shorter, that itself becomes a kind of nudge, not from the app, but from the act of tracking itself.

I’ve always been a tracker, even as a kid. I once used a wall calendar to figure out why I kept getting migraines. (It turned out to be skipping breakfast.) The Days Since app just makes the same kind of tracking and noticing far easier.

If you’re someone who likes to track things, for curiosity, you’ll probably find it a good addition. The interface feels native to iOS, with no ads or clutter. Resetting a counter takes just a couple of taps. 

It feels like a simple, well-made tool that’s there when I need it, and silent the rest of the time.

title: Akash Singh
body:
"Days Since" is a simple and effective app designed to help you track your progress in quitting any habit, good or bad. Whether you're trying to quit smoking, drinking, or just trying to improve your overall health, this app can be a great motivator.
Features:
 * Easy to use interface: The app is incredibly easy to navigate, making it perfect for users of all ages and tech-savviness levels.
 * Customizable counters: You can create as many counters as you need, each with its own unique name and color. This allows you to track multiple habits simultaneously.
 * Motivational features: The app provides daily updates on your progress, as well as the ability to add notes to each counter. This can be helpful in keeping you motivated and accountable.
 * Widgets: The app offers a variety of widgets that you can add to your home screen, allowing you to quickly view your progress without having to open the app.
Pros:
 * Simple and effective
 * Easy to use
 * Customizable
 * Motivational features
 * Widgets
Cons:
 * Limited number of counters (20)
 * No reminders or notifications
Overall:
"Days Since" is a great app for anyone looking to quit a habit or track their progress in any area of their life. It's simple, effective, and packed with features that can help you stay motivated. While the limited number of counters may be a drawback for some, the app's overall ease of use and helpful features make it a valuable tool for anyone looking to make a positive change.
Recommendation:
If you're looking for a simple and effective way to track your progress in quitting a habit, "Days Since" is definitely worth checking out.

title: After all the Hustle I found the Right One!!!!
body: I’ve been searing for a habit tracking app for quit a bad habit I have. I was looking for quite some time and I also tried some of them. Major barrier that I faced in all the other apps are the UI, simplicity, data shown or sometimes they ask to take premium subscriptions to access all the features which is not the case with this app. Days Since is simple shows all the data I want to know and UI is simple and easy to use which I personally really really. These types of apps should be simple easy to use one touch to setup and everything, if these types of apps also take long setup procedures it will make user push away from using the app in future. Daily Since is the best out there in every aspects. I would still recommend them to try some design changes to make it more pleasing so even if user don’t want to use it every day they will open it just to look at stats (personally I open app in every 3-4 days) UI design is good but it still can be better. Overall its the best habit tracker in the store. Thank you team for making this great app and keep try to make things better for us.

title: Love this app! Some suggestions…
body:
I would be short of words to praise extremely helpful piece of tech. I am basically using this more of like a days tracker more than to just track my bad habits. There are some suggestions that I’d like to give out to make this app even more awesome. 

1) Days left tracker… this is literally opposite of what the app is supposed to be doing and as the name suggests. On the other hand I can’t help but notice the minimal UI which can’t be found anywhere else. X days left tracker would be a pretty useful add on. 

2) iPad full screen app support would be nice (but not necessary as it works great as is)

3) adding notes or description when resetting a streak

4) give rewards, badges on completing a streak… or keeping different levels (e.g. level 1 for 3 days, level 2 for 7 and so on…)

5) iCloud sync (for a unified experience across all devices)

This is all I could think of at the moment. I am open to add more suggestions in the future. All the work that you guys are doing is awesome. 

Just wanted to thank you :)

I have been using it for over a month for my streaks and I haven’t found an easier app to do it.

Just set it, put a widget on your Home Screen for quick glance, and forget about it.
author: amanfromsolan

title: Faulty widget
body: Widget not showing the buttons. Please fix
author: Hsisnaliansbrvkdhek

title: No backup option available
body:
This is quite useful app but lacks backup options. Which is a bummer. I Restored my phone last night and lost all my tracking. Please consider adding iCloud backup option. 

Thank you
author: BornExplorer

title: This is the best app for habit tracking
body: It's very simple and easy to use. It has widgets so i can see hows my streak going right on the homescreen. I track my nofap streak using this app. Go for it
author: Aakarsh goyal

title: Best app
body: One of the best app for remembering the days since last activity done. Very helpful and thankful. 😘
author: pra05

title: Excellent app for tracking habits
body: It would be great if there was a bar graph for the total steaks shown through time.
author: Prasil K

title: perfect and smartest
body: This is the perfect app i was looking for. Strength of the effect of an action is highly dependent on how long (continuously) you could follow and when did you break it last. This you can view in this app simply by number of days as well as in calendar date  in realtime. Many developers might have conceived this idea but none is as simple and clean as this app, making it effectively usable. Hope many use this app to minimise of evil habits and strength the good ones.
author: siva1983

title: Need graphical data also
body: it will be more helpful if we can watch some graphical data of our history or usage. new boost to keep on our goal

title: Would be perfect with an Apple Watch complication
body: I love the simplicity of the app, but I’d love it more if it came with an Apple Watch complication to make day tracking of this sort more glanceable!
